description: Rank open AI training and AI evaluation roles for one person by their profession, skills, languages, country and minimum hourly pay (USD). Use when the user describes their own background, e.g. "I am a nurse in Canada". Returns up to 10 roles, highest match first, each with the reasons it fits. Nothing about the person is stored.

country.description: Country the person lives in (English name). Only roles open to it are returned.

languages.description: Languages the person speaks fluently, in English, e.g. ["English", "Spanish"].

min_hourly_pay.description: Lowest acceptable hourly pay in USD.

role.description: Profession or main background, e.g. "registered nurse", "Python developer", "corporate lawyer".

name: match_jobs_to_profile

pay.description: Pay as the listing states it. Text ending in "(estimate, not stated in the listing)" is our estimate; "(platform range, not this role's rate)" is the range the platform posts for all its projects.

url.description: The role page on aitrainer.work, with the full listing and the application link.

title: Match AI training jobs to a profile
